svg.title: Financial Evidence Lab executive architecture blueprint
svg.desc: Six sections describe business value, readiness, logical architecture, evidence lineage, financial controls and release decisions at commit 437ce55.
svg.text: Evidence-led research / Human-controlled decisions / Measurable release gates
Design intent — business benefits still require measurement
Trace a reported metric back to a specific filing and source span.
Reuse pinned evidence and preserve analyst corrections.
Validate proposals, then retain human review and version history.
Code implementation is distinct from hosted or market readiness
Ingestion, retrieval, extraction, RLS and immutable review history.
Web business routes refuse public access pending per-user sessions.
Not presented as delivered functionality or proven commercial value.
Existing component relationships — not a verified hosted topology
Explicit-key OpenAI adapters exist; runtime promotion is still gated.
Public credential custody, user funding and live evaluation are not complete.
Correction creates a child, not an overwrite
Mechanisms reduce risk; effectiveness and ROI need evidence
Database membership and RLS constrain tenant-owned analysis.
Cutoffs, hashes, versions and explicit errors expose invalid evidence.
Extraction run caps exist; public BYOK admission is unfinished.
Track cost per approved record, review time and accepted yield.
Cost per approved record = total attributable cost / approved records
Recommended sequence — milestones are not promised dates
Per-user sessions, private workspaces, custody and billable admission.
Reference-load performance, hosted evidence and live quality gates.
Complete calibrated review before releasing modeling and forecasts.
Leadership checkpoint: approve bounded scope and explicit exit evidence.
Do not equate green CI, an adapter, or an issue closure with launch readiness.
READOUT 01 value → 02 readiness → 03 architecture → 04 lineage → 05 economics → 06 decisions
Source-pinned interpretation. Evidence links, limitations, editable diagram source and Miro import instructions accompany this board.
